diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig to :module.eks duplicates the ordinary attribute references to :module.eks already recorded in implicit_deps.
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class to :module.eks duplicates the ordinary attribute references to :module.eks already recorded in implicit_deps.
The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class to :module.karpenter duplicates the ordinary attribute references to :module.karpenter already recorded in implicit_deps.
The explicit dependency from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :module.karpenter duplicates its implicit dependency on :module.karpenter.

The explicit dependency from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster is already established transitively through its implicit dependency on :module.karpenter, which itself depends on :data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster.

The explicit dependency from :resource.helm_release.karpenter to :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig is already established transitively through :module.karpenter, which depends on :resource.null_resource.apply_tigera_operator, which in turn depends on :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig.

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.apply_node_pool to :module.eks is already established transitively through its dependencies on :resource.helm_release.karpenter and :resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class, both of which depend on :module.eks.

The explicit dependency from :resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset to :module.eks is already established transitively through :resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig, which depends on :module.eks.

The Calico Installation is applied by :resource.null_resource.create_calico_installation, while :resource.null_resource.delete_daemonset removes the EKS aws-node DaemonSet. Applying the Calico installation before that removal could race with the CNI transition; make the installation wait until the DaemonSet deletion has completed.
